externallyOwned.description: Created by infra/bootstrap and never managed by this Terraform. Referenced by ARN or data source. A stage rebuild must not touch them.

resources.name: stokd-agent-workload-boundary
resources.why: Permissions boundary attached to every workload role. It is an allowlist containing no Bedrock or other model-invoke action, which is what makes the model-invoke denial effective rather than merely declared.

resources.name: stokd-agent-validation-deploy
resources.why: The only principal permitted to apply this Terraform. Enforced by the precondition in locals.tf, not merely by convention.

resources.name: stokd-agent-runtime
resources.why: Holds the pinned API, MongoDB and maintenance images. Only exact sha256 digests are accepted; tags are rejected by variable validation.

resources.name: /stokd-agent/shared/validation-certificate/v1
resources.why: Points at the retained exact-SAN ACM certificate. Retained so a stage rebuild never re-issues a certificate.

resources.name: terraform state bucket
resources.why: Terraform state contains generated service credentials (see secrets.tf). The backend MUST be encrypted remote state; a local state file would place those credentials on disk in plaintext.
resources.status: REQUIRED BEFORE FIRST APPLY — does not yet exist

managed.description: Created and owned per stage by this Terraform. Addresses are stable; substitute the stage into every name.

custody.description: Retained across a stage teardown. Every entry carries lifecycle.prevent_destroy, so a destroy that would remove one fails the plan instead of running.

network.description: Rebuildable. Endpoint-only egress: no NAT gateway and no Elastic IP exist, and the manifest asserts both collections are empty.

compute.description: Rebuildable. The MongoDB host is disposable; its data volume is not, which is why they are separate resources joined by an attachment.

supersededScaffold.description: The SST/CloudFormation layout this Terraform replaces. Reference-only: it is never deployed and never extended, per AX-CLOUD-TERRAFORM.
retained: infra/bootstrap/template.yaml — still the owner of the externally-owned bootstrap resources above; not part of the per-stage topology.
infra/runtime/** — host scripts and systemd units, consumed verbatim by the Terraform user data.
infra/shared/constants.ts — stage identity, mirrored by locals.tf.
supersededScaffold.notableDifference: The SST data stack created the three service credentials through a nested CloudFormation stack solely to use GenerateSecretString, keeping plaintext out of SST state. Terraform has no equivalent generator, so random_password is used and the value lands in Terraform state. Encrypted remote state is therefore mandatory rather than advisory.
